summary.description: Two to four sentences: what the PR does and the overall verdict.

ticket_coverage.description: Which acceptance criteria are met, and anything in the ticket the PR does not cover.

path.description: Repo-relative path in the PR head.

line.description: Line number in the PR head version of the file (RIGHT side).

pre_existing.description: True when the problem existed before this PR and the PR only extends it.

body.description: The comment as it will be posted: the defect, a concrete failure scenario, and the suggested fix.
